usedFor: GMass holds campaign emails and their results, and Sangam CRM keeps the lead record through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Email Replied” in GMass, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A reply shows real interest, and the action creates the lead or updates it by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Email Replied” in GMass is polling, so replies reach Sangam CRM after a scheduled check, not at once.
